description: Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije (Surveying and Mapping Authority) publishes the national address register of Slovenia, which holds address numbers, settlements, streets, house numbers and flat or business-premises numbers taken from the real estate cadastre and the spatial units register, with the spatial units around each address centroid. Coverage: the whole of Slovenia; first published in 2017 according to the reference dates, with the portal record last modified on 2026-08-17. Format and access: HTML, downloadable without registration from the Slovenian open data portal (OPSI); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0, named in the portal's licence terms field (access constraints "none"; data publicly available for re-use); cost: free. Caveats: the portal record names CC BY 4.0 in its licence terms and gives access constraints "none"; the register carries no building attributes beyond the address itself. Simulation uses: geocoding and matching of buildings, population and service demand to locations in exposure and accessibility models. Related catalogue records: Slovenia real estate cadastre (Kataster nepremičnin): parcels, buildings and parts of buildings (data-slovenia-gurs-real-estate-cadastre-parcels-and-buildings).
